description.value: Crown Mansion is a fully renovated heritage boutique hotel in Qualicum Beach, dating to 1914, with an elegant past that once saw celebrity guests including Bing Crosby, John Wayne, and the King of Siam. The property retains its original grandeur through rare wood panelling, crystal chandeliers, heritage fireplaces, and sweeping staircases. Accommodation options span boutique hotel rooms and separate villas, with an on-site restaurant rounding out the experience.
